Colorize performance tests for VS Code
Text visualizer for profiles taken from the JavaScript debugger

notebook.formatOnSave.enabled.markdownDescription: Format a notebook on save. A formatter must be available and the editor must not be shutting down. When `#files.autoSave#` is set to `afterDelay`, the file will only be formatted when saved explicitly.

notebook.insertFinalNewline.markdownDescription: When enabled, insert a final new line into the end of code cells when saving a notebook.

notebook.formatOnCellExecution.markdownDescription: Format a notebook cell upon execution. A formatter must be available.

notebook.confirmDeleteRunningCell.markdownDescription: Control whether a confirmation prompt is required to delete a running cell.

notebook.find.filters.markdownDescription: Customize the Find Widget behavior for searching within notebook cells. When both markup source and markup preview are enabled, the Find Widget will search either the source code or preview based on the current state of the cell.

notebook.experimental.remoteSave.markdownDescription: Enables the incremental saving of notebooks between processes and across Remote connections. When enabled, only the changes to the notebook are sent to the extension host, improving performance for large notebooks and slow network connections.

notebook.scrolling.revealNextCellOnExecu.markdownDescription: How far to scroll when revealing the next cell upon running notebook.cell.executeAndSelectBelow.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Scroll to fully reveal the next cell.
Scroll to reveal the first line of the next cell.

notebook.experimental.generate.markdownDescription: Enable experimental generate action to create code cell with inline chat enabled.

notebook.variablesView.markdownDescription: Enable the experimental notebook variables view within the debug panel.

notebook.inlineValues.markdownDescription: Control whether to show inline values within notebook code cells after cell execution. Values will remain until the cell is edited, re-executed, or explicitly cleared via the Clear All Outputs toolbar button or the `Notebook: Clear Inline Values` command.
enumDescriptions: Always show inline values, with a regex fallback if no inline value provider is registered. Note: There may be a performance impact in larger cells if the fallback is used.
Show inline values only when an inline value provider is registered.
Never show inline values.

notebook.cellFailureDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Show available diagnostics for cell failures.

notebook.backup.sizeLimit.markdownDescription: The limit of notebook output size in kilobytes (KB) where notebook files will no longer be backed up for hot reload. Use 0 for unlimited.

notebook.multiCursor.enabled.markdownDescription: Experimental. Enables a limited set of multi cursor controls across multiple cells in the notebook editor. Currently supported are core editor actions (typing/cut/copy/paste/composition) and a limited subset of editor commands.

notebook.markup.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Controls the font family of rendered markup in notebooks. When left blank, this will fall back to the default workbench font family.

chat.agentHost.ahpJsonlLoggingEnabled.description: When enabled, captures AHP transport messages once: in the window for local and remote connections, or on the host for Mission Control connections. Enabled by default only in Insiders. Each logging process stops capture after writing 500 MiB across all connections, including reconnects. Existing per-connection rotation still applies. Restart the window or host process to reset its budget. Mission Control host capture follows the host's owning window setting, including live changes.

chat.agentMerge.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables the experimental Agent Merge controller and its commands. Agent Merge can monitor an agent session's pull request, ask the agent to address selected blockers, and optionally merge the pull request when it is ready. It is paused while `#chat.artifactIntegrations.enabled#` is enabled; its saved choices are preserved.

chat.agentMerge.addressReviews.description: Controls whether enabled Agent Merge sessions address unresolved review threads, changes-requested reviews, and new pull request comments from repository maintainers or the Copilot pull request reviewer.

chat.agentMerge.fixCI.description: Controls whether enabled Agent Merge sessions ask the agent to fix failed required CI checks.

chat.agentMerge.resolveConflicts.description: Controls whether enabled Agent Merge sessions ask the agent to update branches that are behind or resolve merge conflicts.

enumDescriptions: Merges the pull request whenever it is ready, including after Agent Merge has fixed CI failures or addressed review feedback.
Merges the pull request only while Agent Merge has not changed it. Once a repair turn lands a commit, automatic merging turns itself off for that session so the changes can be reviewed.
Never merges the pull request automatically.
chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest.description: Controls whether the Agent Host automatically merges or enqueues pull requests for enabled Agent Merge sessions after all selected maintenance work is complete.

enumDescriptions: Uses the first repository-compatible method in this order: squash, merge commit, rebase.
Uses squash merge when the repository permits it.
Uses a merge commit when the repository permits it.
Uses rebase merge when the repository permits it.
chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod.description: Controls the native merge method used by Agent Merge.

chat.agentMerge.replyAttribution.description: Controls whether review-thread replies posted by Agent Merge include an automated-reply attribution note.

chat.agentHost.multipleChatProviders.ena.description: Enables chats in one Agent Host session to use different agents.

chat.agentHost.moveChats.enabled.description: Enables moving chats between Agent Host sessions and into new sessions.

enumDescriptions: A utility model generates titles immediately.
The active agent names new sessions and chats using rename tools.

Seed titles immediately and refine them in the background if the first response turn completes successfully. On later turns, remind the active agent that it may rename a chat when the generated title is inaccurate or no longer reflects the user's goal.
chat.agentHost.experimental.titleGenerat.description: Controls how new sessions and chats get an automatic title. Changes apply to new sessions; existing sessions and their chats retain their strategy.

chat.artifactIntegrations.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables live state, actions, and opt-in Autopilot for recorded artifacts, including extension integrations. While enabled, Agent Merge is unavailable regardless of `#chat.agentMerge.enabled#`. Switching stops the previous system's automation without clearing saved choices or history. Previously enabled rules can resume when switching back. This does not enable new Autopilot rules or change ordinary artifact recording (`#chat.artifactTools.enabled#`).

chat.artifactTools.enabled.description: When enabled, agents can record artifacts — pull requests, issues, commits, websites, files and other resources — which are surfaced above the chat input.

chat.artifactIntegrations.githubPullRequ.markdownDescription: Check names that do not need to pass before a draft pull request counts as ready for review: before **Automatically Mark Ready** runs for a pull request artifact, and before Agent Merge offers **Mark Ready**. Matching is case-sensitive; `*` matches any text, and other characters are literal. These checks remain visible, are still repaired when required, and must still pass for automatic merging. This setting does not enable automation.

chat.canvases.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether Agent Host Copilot sessions can open Canvases with interactive content in the Agents Window and the Editor Window. Sessions on remote agent hosts also require `#workbench.browser.enableRemoteProxy#`, so canvas pages load through the agent host's network. Running sessions pick up changes to this setting when they next send a request or open a canvas.

description.value: Controls whether Copilot sessions can use Canvases to present interactive content.

chat.agentHost.experimental.autoAttachPu.description: Controls whether the Agent Host automatically discovers and associates a pull request for the currently checked-out branch. When disabled, only pull requests recorded by the agent as artifacts or explicitly selected or created through session actions are considered.

chat.agentHost.experimental.markdownPlan.description: When enabled, agents receive guidance for using rich links to issues, pull requests, commits, sessions, and chats, plus running task markers, when creating or editing Markdown plan documents.

chat.agentHost.experimental.overlapProvi.description: When enabled, agents prepare their session for a new turn, such as starting the runtime session, while the turn-start checkpoint is captured instead of after it. This can shorten the time to the first response, especially on the first turn of a session.

chat.agentHost.experimental.prewarmSessi.description: When enabled, new Agent Host Copilot chats start their runtime and MCP servers before the first message is sent, so connectors are ready sooner. Changes apply to new chats.

chat.agentHost.mcpSkills.enabled.description: When enabled, Copilot agent sessions discover and use skills served by MCP servers. Changes apply to new sessions.

chat.experimental.workspaceSnapshot.description: When enabled, the first turn of a new Copilot agent host chat includes a bounded file-name snapshot of its working directories, so the agent can orient itself without listing the workspace first. File contents are never included.

enumDescriptions: Enforce the limits.
Do not enforce the limits.
chat.agentHost.agentOrchestrationLimits.description: Controls per-session limits, over a sliding one-hour window, on sessions and chats created and messages sent, and the depth of recursive session spawning, by Agent Host session tools. Confirmation requirements and input validation are unchanged.

chat.agentHost.systemProxy.enabled.description: When enabled, Copilot sessions automatically discover and use the operating system's proxy configuration when no proxy environment variable is set.

chat.agentHost.githubMcpServer.enabled.description: When enabled, agent-host sessions include the GitHub MCP server.

chat.agentHost.computerUse.enabled.markdownDescription: When enabled, local Copilot agent sessions on macOS and Windows offer GitHub's Computer Use plugin, which can operate desktop applications. The plugin is downloaded on first use. Turn it on with `/computer on` in a Copilot chat, or when the agent asks. Each application still requires your approval. Changes take effect after a restart.

chat.agentHost.browserUse.enabled.markdownDescription: When enabled, local Copilot agent sessions offer GitHub's Browser Use plugin, which can operate pages in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge through the [GitHub Copilot browser extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/github-copilot/hblomdgalaelcilcdepgohfcogjiijhe). Turn it on with `/plugin enable browser-use` in a Copilot chat, then run `/browser-use:doctor` to check your setup. Requires Node.js 22 or later on your `PATH`. Changes take effect after a restart.

chat.agentHost.experimental.mcpToolRouti.description: When enabled and tool search is available, agent-host sessions offer routing tools for configured MCP servers and Connectors, using server names and cached MCP tool metadata to discover relevant servers. Selecting a routing tool can request authentication and waits for the server's current tools. Connector-owned servers do not show proactive sign-in hints when this setting is enabled. Other servers without routing tools retain proactive sign-in hints. Newly created sessions pick up changes to this setting.

chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled.description: When enabled, the agent host registers the Claude provider, subject to the Claude SDK being reachable. The agent host process must be restarted for changes to take effect.

description.value: Enable Claude Agent sessions in VS Code. Start and resume agentic coding sessions powered by Anthropic Claude Agent SDK directly in the editor. Uses your existing Copilot subscription.

chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled.description: When enabled, extension-provided BYOK ('bring your own key') models can run in agent-host sessions. Changes are synchronized to the running agent host and do not require a restart.

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled.description: When enabled, the agent host registers the Codex provider (subject to the Codex SDK being reachable). Enabling takes effect without restarting the agent host.

description.value: Enable Codex Agent sessions in VS Code. Start and resume agentic coding sessions powered by OpenAI Codex. Usage can be routed through GitHub Copilot or authenticated directly with an OpenAI account.

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.sdkRoot.description: Experimental, for local SDK development only. Absolute path to a directory containing `node_modules/@openai/codex`. When set, the agent host spawns the Codex binary from this tree instead of downloading the SDK. Empty (the default) falls through to the SDK distribution shipped with this build. The agent host process must be restarted for changes to take effect.

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.codexHome.description: Optional override for `$CODEX_HOME`. Controls where the codex binary reads config and writes rollouts. When empty, codex uses its default (`~/.codex`).

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.binaryArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to `codex app-server`. Primarily useful for debugging (for example, `--log-level=debug`).

chat.agentHost.otel.enabled.markdownDescription: When enabled, the agent host emits OpenTelemetry traces from the Copilot SDK. Configurable in user settings only. Either configure `#chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint#` to ship traces to an external collector or enable `#chat.agentHost.otel.dbSpanExporter.enabled#` to capture them locally.

description.value: Controls whether Copilot OpenTelemetry export is enabled. When managed, users cannot override the enterprise value.

chat.agentHost.otel.exporterType.markdownDescription: Exporter backend used by the Copilot SDK when `#chat.agentHost.otel.enabled#` is on. Configurable in user settings only. `otlp-grpc` is downgraded to `otlp-http` transparently in the CLI runtime.

description.value: Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP protocol for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

enumDescriptions.value: Use OTLP over HTTP.
Use OTLP over gRPC.
Console exporter is not selected by enterprise managed settings.
Use the enterprise-managed file exporter.

chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint.markdownDescription: OTLP endpoint URL when exporter type is `otlp-http` or `otlp-grpc`. Configurable in user settings only. Sets `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` inside the agent host process.

description.value: Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP collector endpoint for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

chat.agentHost.otel.captureContent.markdownDescription: When enabled, includes prompt and response content in OTel span attributes. Configurable in user settings only. Sets `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT`. Privacy-sensitive: do not enable in environments that ship spans to shared sinks.

description.value: Controls whether Copilot OpenTelemetry export captures prompt, response, and tool content.

chat.agentHost.otel.outfile.markdownDescription: Output path for span JSON lines when exporter type is `file`. An enterprise-managed telemetry file path takes precedence over user settings. Sets `COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH`.

description.value: Controls the enterprise-managed file export destination for Copilot OpenTelemetry and prevents local file export when an enterprise OTLP destination is configured.

chat.agentHost.otel.dbSpanExporter.enabl.markdownDescription: When enabled, the agent host persists every emitted OTel span to a local SQLite database. Configurable in user settings only. Spans can be inspected via the `Export Agent Host Traces Database` command. Compatible with external exporters: spans are written to SQLite *and* forwarded to the user-configured sink.

chat.agentHost.copilot.m365.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable Microsoft 365 Copilot access and account choice for Copilot Agent Host sessions. When disabled, Microsoft sign-in continues to use GitHub Copilot only.

Changing this setting requires restarting VS Code. It does not switch your active account or service; sign out and sign back in to change accounts.

sessions.chat.experimental.agentsPickerI.description: Controls whether the Agent picker appears in Add Context for chat inputs in the editor and Agents windows when the default agent is selected. While a non-default agent is selected, the picker appears in its usual position.

chat.agentSessions.autoMarkAsDoneMergedS.markdownDescription: After a session with a merged pull request has been inactive for this many days, mark it as Done. Eligible worktrees are safely removed. Set to 0 to disable automatic marking.

chat.agentSessions.autoDeleteMarkedAsDon.markdownDescription: After a session with a merged pull request is automatically marked Done, wait this many additional days, then permanently delete the session. Eligible retained worktrees are safely removed first. Set to 0 to disable permanent deletion.

chat.resources.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether the pinned pills of files the chat recorded, such as its agent's artifacts, can show them above the chat input instead of opening them in an editor.

enumDescriptions: Use the compact card-based variant.
Use the compact variant without cards.
multiDiffEditor.experimental.variant.description: Controls the experimental variant of the multi diff editor.

multiDiffEditor.experimental.fileList.description: Controls whether newly created multi diff editors support a list of the changed files alongside the diffs. Reload the window to apply this change to existing editors.

chat.stickyScroll.enabled.description: Controls whether the current prompt is pinned to the top of the chat transcript while scrolling.

enumDescriptions: Do not show the prompt timeline.
Show an overview ruler beside the transcript scrollbar that fans into prompt pills on engagement.
Show a minimal handle in the transcript's left gutter that opens a list of prompts on hover.
sessions.chatTimeline.display.description: Controls how the prompt timeline is displayed next to the chat transcript in the Agents window.

chat.experimentalSessionsWindowOverride.description: When true, enables sessions-window-specific behavior for extensions.

chat.experimentalModePermissionsPicker.description: Shows mode and permissions in a combined picker with expandable permission choices for Copilot Agent Host sessions.

chat.fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels in chat messages and the chat input.

chat.fontFamily.description: Controls the font family in chat messages.

dictation.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables dictation across the product (chat input, editor, and terminal). When enabled, a microphone button appears in the chat input and the dictation shortcut becomes available. Desktop uses the selected transcription model; web uses cloud transcription.

description.value: Controls whether dictation is available across the product (chat input, editor, and terminal).

markdownEnumDescriptions: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 multilingual streaming RNN-T, run on-device through Microsoft Foundry Local. Works offline; no audio leaves the device. Automatic language selection follows the Voice Mode language setting; when that setting is Automatic, dictation uses the configured display language when supported, then the system or browser locale, with model detection as a fallback. Downloaded on first use and cached on disk.
Cloud transcription through the same Microsoft AI voice service used by Voice Mode. Requires a network connection and GitHub sign-in; audio is streamed to the service.
dictation.model.markdownDescription: The model used for dictation. On-device models download on first use and run locally through Microsoft Foundry Local; the cloud option streams audio to the Microsoft AI voice service. On the web, user and default on-device selections use cloud transcription because local transcription is unsupported. If policy requires on-device transcription, dictation is unavailable on the web.

description.value: Controls the transcription model used for dictation.

enumDescriptions.value: Use the on-device transcription model. Audio does not leave the device.
Use the cloud transcription service. Audio is streamed to the service.

dictation.showTranscript.markdownDescription: Controls whether the transcript is shown while dictating. The final transcript is inserted when dictation ends.

dictation.showButton.markdownDescription: Controls whether the dictation microphone button is shown in the chat input. When hidden, dictation can still be started with its keyboard shortcut.

dictation.experimental.llmCleanup.markdownDescription: Experimental: when dictation ends, the final transcript is passed through a small language model to restore punctuation, capitalization, paragraphs, and lists. Requires Copilot to be enabled; the transcript is sent to the language model for cleanup. Falls back to the raw transcript when no model is available. Use [dictation instructions](command:workbench.action.chat.configureDictationInstructions) to customize terminology and formatting.

description.value: Controls whether final dictation transcripts are sent to a language model for cleanup.

dictation.experimental.llmCleanupModel.markdownDescription: Controls the language model used for experimental dictation cleanup. `auto` follows the experiment-provided default.

chat.editor.fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels in chat codeblocks.

chat.editor.fontFamily.description: Controls the font family in chat codeblocks.

chat.editor.fontWeight.description: Controls the font weight in chat codeblocks.

chat.editor.wordWrap.description: Controls whether lines should wrap in chat codeblocks.

chat.editor.lineHeight.description: Controls the line height in pixels in chat codeblocks. Use 0 to compute the line height from the font size.

enumDescriptions: The agent status indicator is hidden from the title bar.
Shows the agent status as a badge next to the command center.
Replaces the command center search box with a compact agent status indicator and unified chat widget.
chat.agentsControl.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls how the 'Agent Status' indicator appears in the title bar command center. When set to `hidden`, the indicator is not shown. Other values show the indicator and automatically enable `#window.commandCenter#`. The unread and in-progress session indicators require `#chat.viewSessions.enabled#` to be enabled.

chat.unifiedAgentsBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Replaces the command center search box with a unified chat and search widget.

chat.agentSessionProjection.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether Agent Session Projection mode is enabled for reviewing agent sessions in a focused workspace.

enumDescriptions: Do not show external sessions.
Show the 2 most recently updated external sessions from the last 7 days, hiding any that are older than your 2 newest local sessions.
Show external sessions updated in the last 24 hours.
Show external sessions updated in the last 7 days.
Show external sessions updated in the last 30 days.
chat.agentSessions.showExternal.markdownDescription: Controls which external agent sessions are shown. External sessions are sessions that were created in a different application and have not received a message from this application yet.

chat.agentSessions.openInEditor.markdownDescription: Controls whether opening an agent session, from the sessions list or a session link, shows it in an editor instead of the Chat view. Like opening a file, an editor that already shows the session is revealed, and a session shown in the Chat view moves into an editor.

chat.saveBeforeSend.description: Controls whether all dirty editors except untitled editors are saved before sending a chat message.

chat.implicitContext.enabled.description: Enables automatically using the active editor as chat context for specified chat locations.

additionalProperties.description: The value for the implicit context.
enumDescriptions: Implicit context is never enabled.
Implicit context is enabled for the first interaction.
Implicit context is always enabled.

chat.implicitContext.suggestedContext.markdownDescription: Controls whether the new implicit context flow is shown. In Ask and Edit modes, the context will automatically be included. When using an agent, context will be suggested as an attachment. Selections are always included as context.

chat.implicitContext.includeActiveEditor.markdownDescription:
When enabled, the active editor is automatically forwarded as context, even when it would otherwise only be suggested. Selections and explicitly attached files are always included regardless of this setting.

Note: this setting currently only applies to Agent Host sessions (such as Copilot).

chat.editing.autoAcceptDelay.markdownDescription: Delay after which changes made by chat are automatically accepted. Values are in seconds, `0` means disabled and `100` seconds is the maximum.

chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRemoval.markdownDescription: Whether to show a confirmation before removing a request and its associated edits.

chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRetry.markdownDescription: Whether to show a confirmation before retrying a request and its associated edits.

chat.editing.explainChanges.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether the Explain button in the Chat panel and the Explain Changes context menu in the SCM view are shown. This is an experimental feature.

chat.editing.revealNextChangeOnResolve.markdownDescription: Controls whether the editor automatically reveals the next change after keeping or undoing a chat edit.

chat.editing.openChangedFileInDiffEditor.markdownDescription: Controls whether selecting a file in the changed files list of a chat response opens it in a diff editor showing the changes made by chat, or in a regular editor. Holding `kbstyle(Alt)` while selecting the file opens it with the opposite behavior.

chat.editor.workingSet.enabled.description: Show Agent Host session changes as a working set above the chat input instead of the Changes pill in the editor window. Use its context menu to enable or disable Keep and Undo in both the working set and the editor, or choose Show Pill to turn this setting off. View All Edits opens all changed files in a diff editor. Hosts without a session changeset keep the Changes pill. Local and other chat harnesses are unaffected.

chat.tips.enabled.description: Controls whether tips are shown above user messages in chat. New tips are added frequently, so this is a helpful way to stay up to date with the latest features.

enumDescriptions: No animation is shown.
Shows a confetti burst animation around the thumbs up button.
Shows floating thumbs up icons rising from the button.
Shows expanding pulse rings from the button.
Shows radiant lines emanating from the button.
chat.upvoteAnimation.description: Controls whether an animation is shown when clicking the thumbs up button on a chat response.

chat.experimental.detectParticipant.enab.deprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated. Please use `chat.detectParticipant.enabled` instead.
chat.experimental.detectParticipant.enab.description: Enables chat participant autodetection for panel chat.

chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.e.description: Enables incremental rendering with optional block-level animation when streaming chat responses.

chat.experimental.richLinks.enabled.description: Controls whether supported links in chat are rendered as rich links with live metadata. Enabling this may make authenticated requests to services such as GitHub.

enumDescriptions: No animation. Content appears instantly.
Simple opacity fade from 0 to 1.
Content fades in while rising upward.
Content fades in from a blurred state.
Content scales up from slightly smaller.
Content slides in from the left.
Content reveals top-to-bottom with a soft gradient edge.
chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.a.description: Controls the animation style for incremental rendering.

enumDescriptions: Renders content immediately as tokens arrive.
Reveals content word by word.
Buffers content until a paragraph break before rendering.
chat.experimental.incrementalRendering.b.description: Controls how content is buffered before rendering during incremental rendering. Lower buffering levels render faster but may show incomplete sentences or partially formed markdown.

chat.agent.collapseCompletedResponses.description: Controls whether completed chat responses collapse intermediate work while keeping the final response visible.

chat.detectParticipant.enabled.description: Enables chat participant autodetection for panel chat.

chat.experimental.stickyScroll.enabled.description: Controls whether chat requests use experimental tree-based sticky scroll instead of the sticky prompt header.

enumDescriptions: Display file and symbol references as boxed widgets with icons.
Display file and symbol references as simple blue links without icons.
chat.inlineReferences.style.description: Controls how file and symbol references are displayed in chat messages.

chat.inlineAttachments.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether context attached to the chat input, such as files, folders, images, symbols, tools, and pull requests, is shown as pills inline with the prompt text at the position where it was added, instead of above the input. Each inline attachment behaves like a single character: move the cursor across it, select it, or delete it like text. Sent requests show the same pills inline, and still show attached images as thumbnails above their text. The prompt sent to the model mentions each pill by its attachment's name and location, and attaches each attachment once, however often it is mentioned.

chat.editorAssociations.markdownDescription: Configure [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to editors for opening files from chat (for example `"*.md": "vscode.markdown.preview.editor"`).

enumDescriptions: Never show OS notifications for confirmations.
Show OS notifications for confirmations when the window is not focused.
Always show OS notifications for confirmations, even when the window is focused.
chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation.description: Controls whether a chat session should present the user with an OS notification when a confirmation or question needs attention. This includes a window badge as well as notification toast.

chat.autoReply.markdownDescription: Automatically skip question carousels by telling the agent that the user is not available and to use its best judgment. This is an advanced setting and can lead to unintended choices or actions based on incomplete context.

chat.autopilot.advanced.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables **Advanced Autopilot**, a single switch that turns on all advanced Autopilot behaviors that delegate more of the loop to the agent. Currently, after each Autopilot turn a small, fast model evaluates whether your original request is complete; if not, Autopilot keeps working using that evaluation as guidance for the next turn, instead of relying on the agent to signal completion itself.

enumDescriptions: Start new chat sessions with Default Permissions.
Start new chat sessions in Bypass Approvals mode.
Start new chat sessions in Autopilot mode.
chat.permissions.default.description: Controls the default permissions picker mode for new local chat sessions. You can still change the permission mode per session, and each session remembers the permission mode that was used. If your organization disables auto approval, new sessions use Default Permissions.

enumDescriptions: Interactive — step-by-step collaboration.
Plan — plan first, execute when ready.
Autopilot — autonomously iterate from start to finish.
mode.description: The starting mode for new agent sessions.

enumDescriptions: Manual permissions — asks when approval settings don't apply.
Assisted permissions — evaluates risk before running tools.
Allow All — runs tool calls without asking.
approvals.description: The starting approval behavior for new agent sessions. If your organization disables auto approval, new sessions use Manual permissions.

chat.defaultConfiguration.markdownDescription: Controls the default configuration for new agent sessions (such as Copilot). You can still change the mode and approval behavior per session, and each session remembers what was used.

description.value: Sets the default configuration for new agent sessions, as a JSON object with an optional "mode" ("interactive", "plan", or "autopilot") and "approvals" ("manual", "assisted", or "allowAll"). Users can still change them for each session.

chat.defaultModel.markdownDescription: The default model for new chat conversations. Use "auto" to let Copilot pick a model, a model family name (such as "opus" or "gemini") to use the latest available model in that family, or a full model id. An organization-managed default takes precedence over your saved preference. You can still switch the model within a conversation; each new conversation starts at the effective default.

description.value: Sets the default chat model for new conversations. Accepts "auto", a model family name (such as "opus" or "gemini"), or a full model id. Users can still switch the model within a conversation.

chat.tools.global.autoApprove.markdownDescription:
Global auto approve also known as "YOLO mode" disables manual approval completely for _all tools in all workspaces_, allowing the agent to act fully autonomously. This is extremely dangerous and is *never* recommended, even containerized environments like [Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces) and [Dev Containers](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-vscode-remote.remote-containers) have user keys forwarded into the container that could be compromised.

**This feature disables [critical security protections](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/run/security) and makes it much easier for an attacker to compromise the machine.**

Note: This setting only controls tool approval and does not prevent the agent from asking questions. To automatically answer agent questions, use the [`chat.autoReply`](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22chat.autoReply%22%5D) setting.

description.value:
Global auto approve also known as "YOLO mode" disables manual approval completely for all tools in all workspaces, allowing the agent to act fully autonomously. This is extremely dangerous and is *never* recommended, even containerized environments like Codespaces and Dev Containers have user keys forwarded into the container that could be compromised.

This feature disables critical security protections and makes it much easier for an attacker to compromise the machine.

Note: This setting only controls tool approval and does not prevent the agent from asking questions. To automatically answer agent questions, use the `#chat.autoReply#` setting.

chat.permissions.assisted.instructions.description: Custom instructions for the reviewer that decides which tool calls can run without asking when a Copilot session uses Assisted permissions. They take precedence over the reviewer's default guidance but cannot override permission rules, organization policy, or the sandbox, and they are not sent to the agent. Leave empty to use the default guidance.

chat.sessionSync.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable session sync to GitHub.com. When enabled, Copilot session data is synced to your GitHub account for cross-device access and richer insights. Requires `#github.copilot.chat.localIndex.enabled#` to also be enabled.

description.value: Enable session sync to GitHub.com for cross-device Copilot session history. When disabled by organization policy, session data is kept local only.

chat.sessionSync.excludeRepositories.markdownDescription: Repository patterns to exclude from session sync. Use exact `owner/repo` names or glob patterns like `my-org/*`. Sessions from matching repositories will only be stored locally.

chat.tools.edits.autoApprove.markdownDescription:
Controls whether edits made by the agent are automatically approved. The default is to approve all edits except those made to certain files which have the potential to cause immediate unintended side-effects, such as `**/.vscode/*.json`.

Set to `true` to automatically approve edits to matching files, `false` to always require explicit approval. The last pattern matching a given file will determine whether the edit is automatically approved.

chat.tools.urls.autoApprove.markdownDescription:
Controls which URLs are automatically approved when requested by chat tools. Keys are URL patterns and values can be `true` to approve both requests and responses, `false` to deny, or an object with `approveRequest` and `approveResponse` properties for granular control.

Examples:
- `"https://example.com": true` - Approve all requests to example.com
- `"https://*.example.com": true` - Approve all requests to any subdomain of example.com
- `"https://example.com/api/*": { "approveRequest": true, "approveResponse": false }` - Approve requests but not responses for example.com/api paths

chat.tools.eligibleForAutoApproval.markdownDescription: Controls which tools are eligible for automatic approval. Tools set to 'false' will always present a confirmation and will never offer the option to auto-approve. The default behavior (or setting a tool to 'true') may result in the tool offering auto-approval options.
